scopeBasis.macos: Foliole 0.7.15 changes the shared desktop sync protocol, editor focus and crash handling, and Readwise import ownership used by the macOS app, so the macOS package is required.
scopeBasis.windows: Foliole 0.7.15 changes the shared desktop sync protocol and Windows Sync Group behavior verified on the Windows development machine, so the Windows package and direct installer are required.
scopeBasis.linux: Foliole 0.7.15 changes the shared Electron sync protocol and editor behavior used by Linux Experimental, so the Linux Experimental package is required.
